title: Data shapes: one branch with all nine builds is ready to merge

owner_note.text: integration/data-shapes-2 has all nine builds, the planned fixes and all seven checks, with no new test failures. The merge command and the restart steps are in its report, and the branch is not merged. Two small gaps come with it, and both behave the same on michael/dev today: a long session page redraws its task list on every dictated line, and an edited part shows only after the next change to its list.
